name: WeaverAI Memory Fabric
description: Reusable agent memory and context recipes — four-layer system that auto-captures, structures, and profiles conversational knowledge

mode.description: OpenClaw integration mode: local/function (default; runs in the local process using the OpenClaw function/host LLM runner) or client/gateway/remote (lightweight client mode; connects to an external Memory Gateway)

storeBackend.description: Storage backend: sqlite (local SQLite + sqlite-vec) or mongodb (connection from MONGODB_ENDPOINT / MONGODB_DATABASE env). Only effective in local/function mode

server.description: External Memory Gateway connection settings for client/gateway/remote mode

enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic conversation capture

excludeAgents.description: List of Agent glob patterns to exclude (e.g. bench-judge-*); matching agents are not captured, recalled, or scheduled in the pipeline

l0l1RetentionDays.description: Retention in days for local L0/L1 files. 0 = no cleanup; if non-zero it must be >= 3 by default. If 1 or 2, allowAggressiveCleanup must be enabled explicitly

allowAggressiveCleanup.description: Whether to allow high-risk cleanup settings (l0l1RetentionDays=1 or 2)

enableDedup.description: L1 smart dedup (conflict detection based on vector similarity or keywords)

maxMemoriesPerSession.description: Maximum memories per session in a single L1 extraction

model.description: Model used for extraction (format: provider/model); uses the openclaw default model if unset

persona.description: Scene summarization and user persona settings (L2/L3)

triggerEveryN.description: Trigger persona generation every N new memories

backupCount.description: Number of persona backups to keep

sceneBackupCount.description: Number of scene block backups to keep

model.description: Model used for persona generation (format: provider/model); uses the openclaw default model if unset

everyNConversations.description: Trigger L1 batch processing every N conversation turns

enableWarmup.description: Warm-up mode: a new session triggers after 1 turn and doubles after each L1 (1->2->4->...->everyN), speeding up early memory extraction

l1IdleTimeoutSeconds.description: L1 idle timeout (seconds): how long after the user stops talking to trigger L1 batch processing

l2DelayAfterL1Seconds.description: Delay (seconds) after L1 completes before triggering L2

l2MinIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between two L2 extractions for the same session

l2MaxIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum L2 polling interval (seconds) for the same active session

sessionActiveWindowHours.description: Session active window (hours); sessions inactive longer than this stop L2 polling

maxCharsPerMemory.description: Maximum characters injected per L1 memory; 0 means unlimited

maxTotalRecallChars.description: Total character budget for L1 memories injected by auto-recall this turn; 0 means unlimited

strategy.description: Search strategy: keyword, embedding (vector), hybrid (mixed RRF fusion, recommended)

timeoutMs.description: Overall recall timeout (ms); on timeout, memory injection is skipped and a warning is logged

enabled.description: Whether to enable vector search (effectively disabled if provider=none)

provider.description: Embedding service provider: name of a remote service compatible with the OpenAI API (e.g. openai, deepseek); leave empty or set none to disable vector search

proxyUrl.description: Local proxy address (required only when provider=qclaw). When set, embedding requests are forwarded through this proxy, and the original baseUrl is passed as the Remote-URL header

baseUrl.description: API Base URL (required): the API address of the corresponding provider

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions (required; must match the selected model)

sendDimensions.description: Whether to include the dimensions field in the request body. Default true (compatible with Matryoshka truncation of OpenAI text-embedding-3-*). When the target service is a fixed-dimension model such as BGE-M3 that does not support custom dimensions, set this to false, otherwise the server rejects it with HTTP 400 ('does not support matryoshka representation').

conflictRecallTopK.description: Top-K count recalled during conflict detection

maxInputChars.description: Maximum characters of Embedding input text; longer input is truncated and a warning is logged (default 5000, fits the token limit of most models)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a single embedding API call; on timeout the request is aborted and not retried

recallTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout (ms) for the recall path, overrides timeoutMs. The user is waiting, so a shorter value is recommended (e.g. 3000)

captureTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout (ms) for the capture path, overrides timeoutMs. Runs in the background, so a longer value is fine (e.g. 15000)

enabled.description: Whether to enable metrics reporting (structured METRIC JSON via Gateway logs)

type.description: Reporting method: local emits structured JSON logs via the logger

llm.description: Standalone LLM settings - when enabled, L1/L2/L3 extraction bypasses OpenClaw's built-in model and calls the specified OpenAI-compatible API directly. Disabled by default (uses the OpenClaw host model).

enabled.description: Whether to enable standalone LLM mode. When off, the OpenClaw host model is used.

stream.description: Whether to call the upstream with streaming requests (streamText). Default false (non-streaming). Some OpenAI-compatible upstreams that only accept streaming requests need this set to true. WARNING: only effective when standalone LLM is enabled (llm.enabled=true); otherwise the OpenClaw host runner is used and this switch is ignored.

offload.description: Context Offload settings - multi-layer context compression system (independent switch, off by default). Supports two modes: local (processed by a local LLM) and client (reuses the remote service at server.url)

enabled.description: Whether to enable Context Offload (off by default; does not affect Memory features)

mode.description: Offload run mode: local (processed by a local LLM), backend (uses the remote v1 service at backendUrl), client (reuses the remote offload v2 service at server.url), collect (data collection only, no compression). If unset it is inferred automatically: backendUrl present -> backend, server.url present -> client, otherwise -> local

model.description: [local mode] LLM model used by Offload (format: provider/model); uses the openclaw default model if unset

stream.description: [only effective when mode=local] Whether to call the upstream with streaming requests (streamText). Default false (non-streaming). Some OpenAI-compatible upstreams that only accept streaming requests need this set to true. In backend/client/collect modes the remote offload server drives the calls, and this switch is ignored.

forceTriggerThreshold.description: [local mode] Number of accumulated tool pairs after which L1 is forcibly triggered

dataDir.description: [local mode] Custom data directory (absolute path); defaults to ~/.openclaw/context-offload

maxPairsPerBatch.description: [local mode] Maximum tool pairs per L1 batch

l2NullThreshold.description: [local mode] Trigger L2 when the number of node_id=null entries in offload.jsonl reaches this threshold

l2TimeoutSeconds.description: [local mode] Trigger L2 when more than this many seconds have passed since the last L2

mildOffloadRatio.description: Mild compression trigger ratio (of the context window)

mmdMaxTokenRatio.description: [local mode] MMD injection token budget ratio

compactionRatio.description: [client mode] Trigger compression when context usage exceeds this threshold (0-1); reuses server.url as the backend address

backendUrl.description: [Deprecated, use mode=client] Backend service URL; when set, L1/L1.5/L2/L4 go through the backend

backendApiKey.description: [Deprecated, use mode=client] Backend API auth token
